seo.title: SQL editor with autocomplete and EXPLAIN
seo.description: Write SQL with schema-aware autocomplete. Save queries, search local history and inspect EXPLAIN plans on supported databases.

header.title: SQL editor
header.lead: Write SQL with autocomplete that reads your schema, keep the queries you reuse, and see how the database runs them.

bands.title: Autocomplete from your schema
text: Autocomplete suggests tables and columns, aliases, CTEs and subqueries included. Run the current statement, a selection or the whole script; an ordinary batch runs in one transaction and rolls back if a statement fails.
Format with <kbd>⌘⇧L</kbd>, switch on Vim mode, or jump to any table, view or saved query with Open Quickly (<kbd>⌘⇧O</kbd>).
notes: On iPhone and iPad, the Query tab runs SQL without autocomplete.

bands.title: Parameters, history and saved queries
text: Write :customer_id and TablePro asks for the value before the query runs. Search your history by text, source, failures or time range: it keeps {historyEntries} entries for {historyDays} days and never syncs.
Save the queries you reuse, or link a folder of .sql files to the sidebar, with two-way updates and Git status.
notes: Linux has history and saved queries. iPhone and iPad keep the last {historyEntriesIos} queries.

bands.title: EXPLAIN and EXPLAIN Compare
text: Read a query plan as a diagram, a cost tree or the engine’s own output. Run the query again after a change and compare the two runs: timing and plan differences show side by side, and anything under {explainNoise}% counts as noise.

bands.title: Query Insights
text: Find the slow, failing and most-run queries in this Mac’s history. Statements that differ only in their values group together, and two periods compare side by side. It reads local history only: it is not server monitoring, and it uploads nothing.

bands.title: Charts and maps
text: Turn a result into a bar, line, area or scatter chart in the same tab, from the first {chartInspectedRows} rows. Geometry columns open on a map, and selecting a shape finds its row. Result Charts is part of Pro; Map view is free.

more.title: Other query languages
text: Non-SQL engines use their own query language in the editor. MongoDB gets a built-in shell in the style of mongosh.

more.title: Large results
text: A query returns at most {rowCap} rows unless you raise the cap in Settings, up to {rowCapMax}. A LIMIT you write yourself always wins.

more.title: On iPhone and iPad
text: The Query tab highlights SQL, runs and stops it, and shares a result as JSON, CSV or INSERT statements.
